article.headline: Cincinnati's Historic Finals Day: Two Landmark Matches, One Sunday

research.facts:
Cincinnati Finals Day — Historic Double
**Source: sundayguardianlive.com, olympics.com, skysports.com, tennisuptodate.com**
**ATP Final:** Frances Tiafoe (USA, No. 17 seed) vs. Arthur Fils (FRA, No. 21 seed)
- First-ever ATP Masters 1000 final between two Black players (per ATP)
- Both players would be first-time ATP Masters 1000 champions
- Final scheduled not before 4:30 PM ET, August 23
- Tiafoe quote pre-final: "It's going to be a great show. I'm very motivated."
- Tiafoe's second career Masters 1000 final, both at Cincinnati
- Fils: 3rd Masters 1000 SF of 2026 entering, now in first M1000 final
- Confidence: **HIGH** (multiple sources confirm historic angle and finalists)
**WTA Final:** Coco Gauff (USA, No. 4 seed) vs. Jessica Pegula (USA, No. 3 seed)
- First all-American WTA Cincinnati women's singles final since 1970 (56 years)
- Gauff and Pegula were Olympic doubles partners at Paris 2024
- Pegula's 4th WTA final of 2026 (Dubai, Charleston, DC Open, Cincinnati)
- Gauff: defending US Open champion, won Cincinnati in 2023
- Final scheduled August 23, 2026
- Confidence: **HIGH** (confirmed by WTA official, olympics.com, skysports.com, multiple outlets)

article.headline: Pegula Ends Swiatek's Cincinnati Run; Gauff Eases Past Bejlek Into Final

research.facts:
WTA Semifinals
**Source: tennismajors.com, wtatennis.com, sundayguardianlive.com, sofascore.com**
**Pegula def. Swiatek 7-5, 4-6, 6-4 (2h47m)**
- Swiatek had been defending Cincinnati champion and on a 10-match winning streak
- First set produced five consecutive service breaks inside first seven games
- Pegula came back from a break down in the third set to close it out
- Swiatek leveled at 4-3 in 3rd set; Pegula broke back and held
- Swiatek's North American hard-court title defense is over
- H2H record not specified in sources; Swiatek had led H2H 7-5 entering
- Match described as "crazy" and "epic" by WTA and media
- Confidence: **HIGH** (score confirmed by multiple sources)
**Gauff def. Bejlek 6-4, 6-1 (76 min)**
- Gauff dominated, conceded just five games total
- Gauff's first Cincinnati final since 2023 (won title that year)
- Bejlek (CZE, No. 35) had been the Cinderella story (stunned Sabalenka in R16)
- Bejlek's run ends in SFs — still her best Masters 1000 result
- Confidence: **HIGH** (score confirmed multiple sources including tennismajors.com)

article.headline: US Open Fan Week 2026 Opens: Free Admission, Kids' Day, and Federer Returns August 25

research.facts:
US Open Fan Week
**Source: usopen.org, nbcnewyork.com, qns.com, usopentennisinfo.com**
- Fan Week runs August 23–29 at USTA Billie Jean King National Tennis Center, Flushing
- Arthur Ashe Kids' Day: August 23 (opening day), 9:30 AM–6 PM, player appearances/clinics, free
- Fan Access Pass required for all 18+ (free via US Open app)
- Roger Federer exhibition: August 25, 7 PM at Arthur Ashe Stadium
- Teams: Federer + Andy Roddick vs. John McEnroe + Andre Agassi
- Federer's first return to Flushing Meadows since 2019
- First appearance since retirement from professional tennis in 2022
- Tickets sold out (face value ~$238); resale only
- Other events: qualifying matches, Mixed Doubles Championship, media day
- Confidence: **HIGH** (confirmed on usopen.org official and multiple NYC media outlets)
